meaning: Keys are original identities only (bank letter, PlaySnd_PostSound selector, 32-bit sound ID, variant). Names, speakers, events and PT-BR wording are not inferred. decoded_seconds is derived from decoded_bytes and the header sample rate.
reachability: UseBank_GetDataHeader selects (n-1) & counter; variants outside that set are present in the bank but never selected by the original request path.
